title: CFT Complexity and Penalty Factors
journal: Journal of High Energy Physics, Feb 2026, article 247
topic: Worldline formalism / holographic transport / MERA-AdS connections
summary: General framework for quantum complexity of CFT states using penalty factors that assign relative weights to generators of the conformal group. Uses (pseudo-)Riemannian submersions to construct a complexity metric on coset spaces. Contains a MERA complexity connection and treats holographic complexity observables as probing black hole interiors.
key_findings: Penalty factors on Lie group generators yield richer complexity geometry than uniform cost
Framework applies to CFT complexity measured via MERA circuits as a concrete realization
Positive-definite metric with complexity interpretation exists for specific penalty factor choices
Direct holographic connection: complexity probes black hole interior geometry
project_relevance: Relevant background for HYP-2026-008 (stress-tensor excitations and graviton forces). The penalty factor framework could formalize the distinction between scalar (Delta=1) vs stress-tensor (Delta=2) excitations in our force measurement: they correspond to different generators of the conformal group with different weights. Not immediately actionable but relevant to theoretical interpretation of our force profile measurements.
